_note: Hand-maintained. The dashboard never writes to this file. Add an entry when a company guides to a dated event; delete it or set "happened" once it lands. Dates accept YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-Qn or YYYY-Hn — use the coarsest form the company actually gave, so the page never implies more precision than the source. drug_key is the slug of drug_name in seed-list.csv (and is validated at build time); leave it out for watchlist programmes that are not yet on the seed list and give "subject" instead. Types: fda_decision, readout, trial_start, regulatory, presentation, other.

catalysts.title: PDUFA date
catalysts.detail: FDA decision on the NDA for moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis, under priority review. EMA MAA also accepted. Would be the first approval of a computationally designed drug on this list.

catalysts.title: First-line Phase 3 start
catalysts.detail: Company guidance of "early 2027" for the 1L Phase 3 in PIK3CA-mutant HR+/HER2- breast cancer. ReDiscover-2 is already recruiting.

catalysts.title: Registrational trial start
catalysts.detail: Planned for 2H 2027 in familial adenomatous polyposis, after positive TUPELO Phase 1b/2 data in November 2026.

catalysts.title: Hair-loss proof of concept
catalysts.detail: HEADLINE trial proof-of-concept data in androgenetic alopecia, guided for 2H 2026.
